objective.text: Construct a fresh mailable per loop iteration to avoid accumulating recipients.

difficulty.rationale: Avoid accumulated addressing state when sending individualized messages in a loop.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A loop reuses one mailable instance in Mail::to($address)->send($mail). The second message unexpectedly includes the first recipient too. Which repair addresses the accumulated recipient state?

options.text: Queue the same reused mailable instead of sending it.
options.rationale: Queueing does not prevent recipient lists accumulating before each payload is serialized.
options.misconception: Queueing does not prevent recipient lists accumulating before each payload is serialized.

options.text: Change only the subject before every send.
options.rationale: Changing a header value does not reset the existing recipient list.
options.misconception: Changing a header value does not reset the existing recipient list.

options.text: Create a fresh mailable inside each loop iteration.
options.rationale: PendingMail adds recipients to the mailable; a new instance starts each individualized message with clean addressing state.

options.text: Move the same reused object into a static property.
options.rationale: A longer-lived shared object retains rather than removes its accumulated state.
options.misconception: A longer-lived shared object retains rather than removes its accumulated state.
